about: CHA-only dispatch edges on in-module interfaces in lima-vm/lima f47461ed (linux/amd64), adjudicated by reading the code before the draw. First matching rule wins; `sites` are files or file:line ('*' = any). Every CHA-only edge of the linux dump must match a rule (goldmodel.load require_all). Promoted-wrapper receivers are spelled (*pkg/x.T) / (pkg/x.T).
